breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic boundary condition and only included the Dirichlet conditions, thus resolving the inconsistency.
